scenario_toml:
# F1, held: one instance stays dead for three minutes, past the 120 s
# `storage.balancing.missing_worker_ms`, to see whether its actors fail over
# before it returns (rivet-dev/rivet#5957).
name = "instance-down-long"
seed = 42
duration_s = 300

[workload]
ledgers = 50
processes = 16
pacing_ms = [50, 200]
call_timeout_ms = 5000
agent_sessions = 10

[[nemesis]]
fault = "kill"
target = ["engine-1", "engine-2", "engine-3"]
at_s = 60
heal_after_s = 180

[checks]
quiesce_s = 30
recovery_deadline_s = 300
